reference_set.name: Coffee Bar Gallery 12
reference_set.source_folder_name: 用所选项目新建的文件夹 3
reference_set.scope: Only background material, lighting pattern, tonal falloff and ticket shadow are style references.
reference_set.preservation: Do not copy the reference photograph, people, text, codes or incidental ticket rendering.

global_rules: 只提取图集中的背景材质、光型、明暗范围和票根悬浮关系，不复制参考照片、人物、文字或编号。
背景永远服务于主体，不抢主体视觉层级。
默认保持主体内容、人物、文字、日期、条形码、比例和版式不变。
光影属于背景平面；票根安全区不得出现假卡片轮廓、矩形光斑或第二张卡片。
保持真实材质、自然光衰减和克制色差，禁止廉价软件渐变与塑料感。

soft_daylight.safe_zone: no high-contrast edge in the ticket-safe region

afternoon_sun.safe_zone: keep hard edges outside important subject edges

gallery_light.safe_zone: keep the center calm and readable

center_spotlight.safe_zone: no halo outline around the subject

right_grazing_daylight.pattern: broad right-side key light with a darker upper-left field
right_grazing_daylight.safe_zone: allow gentle tonal drift only; no light rectangle

soft_diagonal_window.pattern: two very broad feathered diagonal window-shadow bands
soft_diagonal_window.safe_zone: shadow bands stay low contrast and never resemble borders

broad_center_glow.pattern: large vertical oval illumination with invisible falloff boundary
broad_center_glow.safe_zone: no circular halo or hard spotlight edge

cinematic_center_falloff.pattern: restrained center lift with mature peripheral falloff
cinematic_center_falloff.safe_zone: vignette remains outside the subject hierarchy

dappled_afternoon.pattern: large defocused organic sunlight patches with no recognizable leaves
dappled_afternoon.safe_zone: no dark patch crosses text, faces or barcode

paper_halo.pattern: tall diffuse paper halo with quiet side falloff
paper_halo.safe_zone: the halo has no visible ellipse boundary

vertical_soft_beams.pattern: broad vertical light columns with feathered side curtains
vertical_soft_beams.safe_zone: columns remain wider than the subject and low contrast

architectural_diagonal.pattern: one decisive architectural diagonal beam plus a softer secondary band
architectural_diagonal.safe_zone: beam edges do not create a frame around the subject

limewash_diffusion.pattern: broad irregular wall wash that reveals subtle lime texture
limewash_diffusion.safe_zone: no bright hotspot beneath text or barcode

stone_diagonal.pattern: wide diagonal illumination that gently reveals stone pores
stone_diagonal.safe_zone: stone contrast remains secondary to the subject

top_gallery_glow.pattern: symmetrical overhead glow fading smoothly toward the lower corners

upper_left_spotlight.pattern: oblique upper-left spotlight with controlled deep peripheral falloff
upper_left_spotlight.safe_zone: retain readable separation around the subject without a glowing edge

subject_preservation_modes.strict: Preserve the original subject exactly. Do not redesign the ticket, card, poster, product or photo. Keep original proportions, typography, people, faces, layout, dates, barcode, image content and key visual elements unchanged.
subject_preservation_modes.balanced: Preserve all important subject content and information. Allow only restrained edge cleanup and natural integration of subject lighting and shadow.
subject_preservation_modes.creative: Preserve identity and essential information, but allow limited visual integration between subject and background when the user explicitly requests it.
